item.title: Columbus airport: New, expanded flights for spring break, summer 2026
item.description: The Columbus Regional Airport Authority has announced new and expanded routes for 2026, including flights to Panama City Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Los Angeles, Montreal, Greenville-Spartanburg, Key West, and Austin, Texas.
